title: A census sends a model only what no tool can decide, and states its reading cost before it reads
goal: A census of the public root runs its mechanical phases (fact diff, verdicts, bookkeeping of phase-2 results, dates, decision sweep) as tool commands with no agent turn between them; the sources it hands a model are only those no provider signal, anchor or word-for-word match can settle, and those are judged on passages by the cheapest model that holds the census's sample agreement; census.py prints the reading queue's size and estimated tokens before phase 2 starts, and each phase's wall time, rows and model spend are recorded, so a census's cost is measured against the 2026-09-26 baseline (1907 sources, 469 sent to model reading, 255 of those confirmed unchanged).
notes: Baseline, from kb/public/_census/2026-09-26.csv (census.py summary, and a tally of its non-OK rows by bucket, kind, evidence and outcome, run 2026-10-10): 1907 sources, OK=1438, CHANGED=42, GONE=14, NEWER-VERSION=13, NEEDS-READING=400; phase 2 read 469 rows and recorded confirmed=255, updated=68, superseded=144, unconfirmed=2. The largest read groups: live pages with no last-updated date (about 205 rows, about 163 confirmed unchanged; ST-ylxsns5t), MicrosoftDocs/memdocs pins (114, all superseded; only 4 live memdocs rows remain on 2026-10-10, so no story), github.com pages (50, 32 confirmed; ST-ai2xlm7x), pinned files changed or newer (about 20, most confirmed; ST-wfvkk6jn), name-resolution errors (10; ST-6d4mvn7z). Anchors on 2026-10-10 (factdiff.py anchors): located 6588 of 13571 pairs, unlocated no-match 5088, not-text 1793 (ST-kbrsd24q). The orchestrator's hand work per phase-2 group (grouping, briefs, kbid.py add per new row, ledger bullets, record, re-anchor, index) moves into census.py (ST-6ljkrwt2, ST-qo3kicix); the phases with no judgment become two commands (ST-ywxl7ulm); reading moves to passages and smaller models (ST-xy2euufe, ST-jlezjp6k, ST-yiq2heb5); ST-t67jhly3 measures the whole route. Out of scope: what counts as confirmed (the skill's rule that a date moves only after comparison stays), the census tag's condition, and _sources.csv rows written by anything but kbid.py. The suite has no census or factdiff test on 2026-10-10 (the old _tools/test_census.py went with the suite rewrite under the ceiling; 54 test ids of 100, 12 files of 15): the stories share one new file, _tools/test_census_route.py, with one test id each, and run one after another in the order their depends_on gives, since nearly all change _tools/census.py.
